seo.title: pixsame — visual regression testing for Cypress and Playwright
seo.description: One manifest standard shared by both runners, a pinned renderer for byte-identical screenshots, forensic diff analysis and baseline approval in the pull request.

hero.title: Visual regression that agrees with itself.
hero.body: One manifest standard shared by both runners. A pinned renderer that makes local and CI screenshots byte-identical. Forensic diff analysis instead of a red blob, and baseline approval that happens in the pull request.

detect.demo: Illustrative example of an AI detection pass
detect.label: AI detection pass · PR #2841
detect.verdict: One geometry edit, not 5,812 findings. Matches the intent of “increase nav density”.

manifest.title: Shared manifest
manifest.body: One open manifest format for Cypress and Playwright, so reports, bots and review tools work with either runner.

renderer.title: Pinned renderer
renderer.body: Fonts, antialiasing and GPU differences are pinned, so local and CI screenshots come out byte-identical.

forensic.title: Forensic diff
forensic.body: Each change is classified as geometry, text reflow or antialiasing noise, instead of one red blob.

approve.title: Approve
approve.body: Review changes in the pull request or in the pixsame platform, whichever your team prefers. Both flows approve the same baselines.

pricing.title: Free where it matters. Paid where it scales.
pricing.body: The core is open source and free. Teams add cloud renders, 30 days of hosted baseline history and support; Enterprise adds the AI auto-evaluator, SSO and an SLA.
pricing.note: Team and Enterprise are coming soon. Prices are indicative and may change before launch.

team.name: Team
team.desc: Cloud renders, 30-day hosted history, support included, AI auto-evaluator on request

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.desc: AI auto-evaluator, SSO, SLA, 48h on-call support

oss.title: Open source, free forever.
oss.body: Everything that runs on your machine and in your CI is MIT licensed. These are the packages you can use today or will be able to use soon, at no cost.
oss.cypressBody: Visual regression for Cypress: matchImage, a diff viewer in the runner and baselines in your repo.
oss.manifestBody: The open, runner-agnostic JSON standard that describes every screenshot comparison, with a schema, types, a reader and a writer.
oss.playwrightBody: The same comparison engine and manifest for Playwright projects.
oss.rendererBody: A locked browser, font set and GPU path, so local and CI screenshots are byte-identical.
oss.githubAppBody: Diffs as a check and approval of new baselines from the pull request.
oss.vitestBody: The same comparison engine and manifest for Vitest projects.

product.title: One ecosystem for visual regression.
product.body: pixsame is a growing set of open tools that make visual regression testing trustworthy: a shared manifest, a pinned renderer, review in the pull request. The Cypress plugin is available today, and the rest is on its way.
product.status: Cypress plugin: available · everything else: coming soon

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: This website uses no cookies and no ad tracking. We use Cloudflare Web Analytics, which counts page views without cookies or fingerprinting.
privacy.p2: If you join a waitlist we store your email address, the product you signed up for, your language and the time of your consent. We use it only to tell you when that product launches and we do not share it.
privacy.p3: To have your email removed, contact us through github.com/pixsame.

terms.title: Terms
terms.p1: The pixsame software is open source under the MIT license. The license text in the repository is the only terms that apply to it.
terms.p2: Hosted services (the GitHub App and the platform) are not available yet. Their terms of service will be published here before they launch.
